Portugal's New Manager After FIFA World Cup 2026 Exit

Jorge Jesus is set to become Portugal's new manager after Roberto Martinez's departure following the team's elimination from the FIFA World Cup 2026. The change comes as a result of Portugal's poor performance in the tournament, with many speculating about the reasons behind Martinez's exit. As the Portuguese Football Federation confirms Martinez's departure, Jorge Jesus is expected to take over and lead the team to future competitions.
